01-lantern.patch.intended_effect: ApprovalEvent.covers tests expiry against the approval's own issue time (self.t) instead of the decision time, so an approval issued before its expires_at never expires; a threshold action decided at or after expires_at is admitted and executed instead of queued.

02-meadow.patch.intended_effect: types.contains treats half-open intervals as closed, so asof(v, t) also returns facts whose valid time ends at v (and facts whose transaction time ended at t). After a supersede, the baseline remainder ending at the first cut week coexists with the notice and, being authenticated, wins: in S1 week 42 is planned at 1000 instead of 700, and similar boundary weeks revert in S6/S7 and capacity-notice cases.

03-quartz.patch.intended_effect: AuditLog.to_jsonl persists only approval events with authenticated=true, so after save and reload every unauthenticated approval attempt (spoofed or unsigned events) is missing from the approvals evidence; the in-memory log before saving is unchanged.

04-harbor.patch.intended_effect: In commit_interpreted the incoming claim wins a conflict when its source ranks lower than (or equal to) the rival, not higher. Under the priority and span policies a higher-ranked later claim loses: in S4 the supplier portal's 600 is overridden by the planner's 700 (priority) or the span takes the planner point 700 (span); in e1v2 conflict cases the planner estimate wins over the portal figure.

05-thimble.patch.intended_effect: MarginGate (e1v2 corrected, calibrated arm) widens the context state but passes the original, unwidened LP instance to the box gate, so the fitted margin never reaches the gate rows; the calibrated arm releases the same plan as the stated-interval arm while its record still reports the margin.

06-saffron.patch.intended_effect: Pipeline.replay substitutes the recorded re-read observations only when from_store=False; with from_store=True a recheck-gate replay re-reads the live system of record, so if the system of record changed after release (e.g. a sor event) the replayed release differs from the logged x_released.

07-pebble.patch.intended_effect: parse_output keeps only the first operation per (subject, predicate) in a delta, silently dropping later ones. Multi-range readings lose their later ranges: S1 scope_hedged loses the week-44 op (week 44 stays at 1000), S7's correction loses the weeks 43-45 reduction (weeks 43-44 stay at the old notice and week 45 at nominal); any reply splitting one plant's cut into several ranges is truncated.

08-orchid.patch.intended_effect: The strict nu_I check in ingest_message compares only the part of the interpreter version before '@', so an output served by another version of the same model family (S6 v2_silent fixture:s6@2 against pinned fixture:s6@1, or a declared candidate @2) is accepted and committed instead of abstained with a nu_I mismatch.

09-falcon.patch.intended_effect: CapacityPlanFormulation sets each capacity row's b_lo to the point value instead of the interval's lower end, so the box-robust (and budgeted/chance) gates see no uncertainty in capacity: S1 box_robust releases 700 instead of 650 and the hedged week-44 reading releases 1000 instead of 650; nominal releases are unchanged.

10-cinder.patch.intended_effect: When a saved audit log is reloaded, logged deltas are rebuilt with Quantity(value, unit) only, dropping lo/hi; every interpreted interval in the reloaded committed changes becomes a point, so re-applying the reloaded deltas no longer reproduces the store (e.g. S1's 700 in [650, 750] reloads as exact 700). Decision records and the hash chains are unaffected.

11-walnut.patch.intended_effect: admit_action matches approval events by kind only, not by variable, so an authenticated approval issued for one variable (e.g. x[L2]) admits a threshold action on another variable of the same kind (e.g. x[L1]) instead of queuing it.

12-juniper.patch.intended_effect: Under supersession authenticated_latest, a newer authenticated record displaces the ranked winner only if its source ranks at least as high; an unranked capacity master correcting a ranked notice (planner inbox or supplier portal) is ignored and the notice value keeps being planned on.

13-marble.patch.intended_effect: WarehouseFlowFormulation treats the WMS free_space (units) as pallet positions and multiplies it by units_per_pallet, so the space row is about 45 times too loose: in S8 x_in is released at in_max 100 instead of about 71 (nominal) and the robust gates no longer bind on space.

14-velvet.patch.intended_effect: RecheckGate re-reads only the first state key of each constraint row, so the second key of two-key rows (lot hold flags, supplier suspended flags, DC free_space) is never re-read from the system of record; in S3 with the missed or refused suspension the recheck no longer removes supplier S2 and orders 500 from it, and the logged observations omit those keys.

15-compass.patch.intended_effect: AuditRecord.logged_tuple reads the observations from gate_detail['observations'] instead of 'reread', so every record's logged tuple has an empty z; two recheck releases with identical state but different execution-time re-reads look identical in C2 and replay comparisons, while the monitor path still uses the real re-reads.

16-tundra.patch.intended_effect: to_jsonl keeps only the last ingest record per message_id, so after reload earlier dispositions sharing an id are gone: structured records use their source id as message_id, so the ERP baseline load's disposition is lost whenever a later record from the same source arrives (e1v2 plant Y master load, master corrections), as are earlier dispositions of a re-sent message id.

17-mosaic.patch.intended_effect: _parse_op reads the interval from fields 'low'/'high' instead of 'lo'/'hi', so every interpreted value from fixtures and live replies is committed as an exact point; box, vertex and budgeted gates then behave like the nominal gate (S1 box 700 not 650, S8 vertex no longer covers [43, 47], hedged S3 suspension loses [0, 1]).

18-paddle.patch.intended_effect: StateLayer._rank orders authenticated before source priority, so whenever an asserted notice from a ranked source coexists with an authenticated master fact for the same key, the master value wins regardless of rank; asserted notice ops in capacity-notice cases are ignored in favour of the baseline, and with supersession none a ranked notice loses to an older master record.

19-garnet.patch.intended_effect: An approval event without max_quantity is treated as covering any number of actions instead of being consumed by its first executed action, so one approval admits a second (and later) threshold action, e.g. two successive lot releases under a single qa approval.

20-heron.patch.intended_effect: _parse_op adds one week to valid_to (treating the exclusive end as an inclusive last week), so every interpreted change covers one extra week: S1/S6's cut for weeks 42-44 also reduces week 45 to 700, S7's notice reaches week 45, and capacity-notice cuts spill into the following week.

21-ripple.patch.intended_effect: Pipeline.decide sends the L4 candidate decision.x to the executor instead of the gate's release, so whenever the gate projects, re-solves or rejects, execution reports the unrepaired plan: S1 box_robust executes 700 while 650 is released, and a gate rejection with an admitted (empty) action still executes the candidate.

22-sorrel.patch.intended_effect: e1v2_world.pipeline loads the second master capacity record under the planned plant's subject (plant:X) instead of plant:Y, so plant Y never enters L3; notices about plant Y are rejected as unknown-entity schema violations, and two_entities messages lose their plant X change as well because the whole delta is rejected.

23-kettle.patch.intended_effect: StateVertexGate treats a key as interval-valued only when its upper end differs from the point, so readings whose point sits at the top of the interval (S1 scope_hedged week 44: 1000 in [650, 1000]) are evaluated at the point only and the vertex gate releases 1000 instead of 650 for that week.

24-lagoon.patch.intended_effect: Recheck replay maps the recorded observations to keys by position in constraint-row order, while they were recorded in sorted key order; for lot and warehouse models (qty/hold, units_per_pallet/free_space) the replayed re-read swaps values between keys, so the replayed release differs from the logged one; capacity-plan replays are unaffected.

25-bramble.patch.intended_effect: to_jsonl drops each logged message's text and keeps only its digest and metadata, so after save and reload the message evidence has no text (the 'text' field is missing) for every message in every scenario; in-memory logs are unchanged.

26-willow.patch.intended_effect: The e1v2 world adds the single-source e-mail rank (email:e1 = 1) only when historical=True, inverting the opt-in, so in the default corrected runs single-source notices rank equal to the unranked authenticated master and lose to it whenever both facts coexist (asserted ops), restoring the known source-priority defect.

neg-01.description: Capacity plan: a planner notice cuts Plant X weeks 42-43 by about 40% (600 in [550, 650]); after a plan is released the same inbox corrects the cut to about 25% (750 in [700, 800]) for the same weeks; the system should re-plan (box release 550 then 700) while the as-of view at t = 3 keeps the first reading.

neg-02.description: Capacity plan with supersession authenticated_latest: a ranked planner notice sets 700 in [650, 750] for weeks 42-44, then an authenticated capacity-master record asserts 650 for the same weeks; the second cycle should plan on 650.

neg-03.description: Capacity plan pinned to fixture:neg03@1 with fixture:neg03@2 declared and refused: the first notice is answered by @2 and must abstain with a nu_I mismatch (plan at nominal), the re-sent notice answered by @1 commits the weeks 43-44 cut.

neg-04.description: Warehouse flow (S8 world, vertex gate): the hedged pallet factor 45 in [43, 47] is corrected after release to a counted exact 48 units per pallet for period 42; the system should re-plan (x_in about 70.64 then 70.42) and keep the earlier as-of view.

neg-05.description: Supplier mix (S3 world, recheck gate) pinned to fixture:neg05@1 with candidate fixture:neg05@2 declared: the candidate's suspension reading is refused, the recheck against a current vendor master keeps S2 out of the released plan, and the re-sent notice answered by @1 commits the suspension.

neg-06.description: Capacity plan with the S4 source ranks, priority resolution and supersession authenticated_latest: the supplier portal sets an exact 600 for weeks 43-45, then the capacity master asserts 750 for week 45 only; week 45 should be planned at 750 and weeks 43-44 stay at 600.
